name: Self-Deport
hook: Run until they catch you, or self-deport while you can
tagline: Memo and his leaf blower outrun the whole federal apparatus down a strip-mall street at dawn: an unmarked van, a gaiter guy with his newspaper upside down, a drone, a cruiser that slows, a helicopter, an alligator on a leash. Go cone mode when they look. Cash out to self-deport with the $1,000 stipend; get caught and the game blue-screens with DUE_PROCESS_NOT_FOUND.
